svg.title: Personal AI Digest architecture
svg.desc: A Cloudflare Worker fires a GitHub Actions workflow at 09:11 and 20:11 Eastern. The send job picks topics from a curriculum, retrieves and distills evidence from the knowledge store, and asks Ollama Cloud to write the lessons. A quality gate rejects any lesson whose factual paragraphs do not cite the evidence, and passing lessons are emailed over SMTP. A send log committed to git prevents double sends. A separate ingest job chunks, tags, and embeds sources into the store, which is SQLite or Postgres with pgvector.
